header.title: Board update: Q3 2026
header.subtitle: Quarter in review and the Q4 plan at a glance

headline: We hit adoption and event targets; membership growth stalled in the mid-market and needs a decision on pricing.
ask: Approve the Q4 marketing budget of $410K, and decide whether to open a Silver tier at $20K for companies under 1,000 employees.

blocks.title: Q3 goals vs outcomes
blocks.subtitle: From the Q3 marketing plan, approved 2 July

items.goal: Grow developer adoption of the core SDK

items.note: Seven prospects stalled on price; all are 200 to 900 employee companies.
Course shipped 6 weeks late; enrollment pace since launch is on target.

items.label: Mid-market prospects stalled on price.
items.text: Without a lower tier we lose them to a competing foundation launching in November.

items.label: Renewals due in Q1.
items.text: Six are members who have not engaged this year; Member Success is on each one.

items.label: Maintainers leaving a top project.
items.text: Succession plan is in place; TOC reviews it 20 October.

items.label: Budget $410K.
items.text: 52% adoption, 28% membership, 20% training; 10% held as reserve.

items.label: Three goals carried forward,
items.text: one new: a European community program.

items.label: Board asks:
items.text: introductions to two named prospects each; speaking slots at member events.

items.question: Approve the Q4 marketing budget of $410K?
items.detail: Detail in the Q4 plan deck, slides 9 and 10.

items.question: Open a Silver membership tier at $20K for companies under 1,000 employees?
items.detail: Projected 7 signings in Q4 and $140K in 2027 revenue; dilution analysis attached.

items.question: Should the foundation host the proposed governance working group?
items.detail: Scope and staffing options for discussion; no decision needed today.

footer: Sources: LFX Insights and Q3 marketing plan review, 3 October 2026. Budget figures from the Q4 marketing plan deck.
